messages:
incident-bot: P0 page for tenant=AureliaBank — high 5xx and tail latency from dedicated pool eu-west-4. Alert rule: dedicated_pool_error_rate > 5% for 3m. Paging on-call.
maria gonzalez: I'm on it, grabbing logs and verifying impact. Can someone confirm customer-reported errors? @aurelia-sre any direct reports?
aurelia-sre: seeing elevated error reports from their support queue. ~15% of API calls returning timeout/502 over last 10m. They reported degraded UX on credit-check flow.
alex chen: checking routing layer. Observed a spike in KV cache misses and GPU OOMs on nodes in dedicated-eu-west-4a group. Some models failing during attention memory alloc.
samir patel: which model variants are in the tenant pinset? can we quickly fallback to safe variant?ops-bot: tenant routing summary for AureliaBank: pinned_models: [owl-13b-pt-v3], live_pool: dedicated-eu-west-4a, fallback_policy: region-rotate -> public-hosted.
jess taylor: recommended immediate mitigation: pin to a low-memory safe variant (owl-13b-slim-quant) or route to hosted safe variant. Prefer keep in-dc traffic to preserve data locality. propose: emergency pin to owl-13b-slim-quant for all AureliaBank routes and enable short TTL (30m) then monitor.
maria gonzalez: agree. Need owner to run model pin and verify no regressions. @alex can you run the pin and smoke a few endpoints?
alex chen: on it. running route update now.

# emergency pin
redwoodctl tenant patch --tenant aurelia-bank \
  --pin-model owl-13b-slim-quant --pin-ttl 1800 --reason "P0 dedicated pool degradation"

alex chen: command applied, routing committed. ops-bot: routing change recorded in audit (audit_id: aud-220123-a1). Starting canary traffic to 5% of requests.
samir patel: canaries show 200/200 for text-generation at 5%. Latency improved 40% on canary; no immediate correctness regressions in customer-critical prompts (sanity set ran).jess taylor: great — escalate next: bump canary to 25% for 10 minutes, if stable flip 100%.
maria gonzalez: Aurelia SRE — please confirm we aren't breaking any encrypted inference flows (they use KMS key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-4:111:kmskey/aurelia-prod). aurelia-sre: KMS usage unaffected, we validated wrapped keys for canary calls. No auth failures.

ops-bot: model runtime metrics for pinned variant: mem_usage ~58% per-gpu, error_rate 0.9%, p95 latency down from 1.8s -> 1.1s.

maria gonzalez: increasing canary to 25% now.

alex chen: canary at 25% applied.

[~10 minutes later]

maria gonzalez: telemetry stable for 12m at 25%. No new 5xx bursts. Customer success on call confirmed error rate trending to baseline. We're ready to promote to 100%.
samir patel: before we promote, add short-term safeguards: enable automatic fallback to public-hosted safe variant if errors exceed 3% for 5m, and turn on KV prefix caching for their heavy endpoints.
jess taylor: commands:

```
# enable hosted fallback
redwoodctl fallback set --tenant aurelia-bank --policy "hosted-safe:owl-13b-slim-quant" --trigger "errors>3%:5m"

# enable prefix caching for endpoint /v1/credit-check
redwoodctl cache set --tenant aurelia-bank --endpoint /v1/credit-check --prefix-ttl 600
```

alex chen: promoting to 100% now.

ops-bot: rollout succeeded. routing now pinned to owl-13b-slim-quant for AureliaBank (pin_ttl=1800). Audit aud-220123-a2.
maria gonzalez: notify Aurelia support and product: messaging drafted, sending now. Also opening post-incident ticket to investigate root cause (OOMs) and consider model quant/compile differences that caused failures.

morgan lee: logging a follow-up item: repro steps + heap profiles from failing nodes copied to artifacts S3:s3://redwood-incident/220123-aurelia/ — include model binary, kernel selection logs.

aurelia-sre: thank you. please include our app logs; we'll coordinate a maintenance window if needed.
samir patel: temporary mitigation notes for postmortem: - immediate pin to slim-quant variant - enabled hosted fallback policy - KV prefix caching on critical endpoint - canary promotions and TTL-based auto-revert

jess taylor: follow-up runbook items (owners assigned):
- infra (alex) -> collect GPU OOM stacktraces, kernel selection logs
- runtime (samir) -> evaluate quant profile diffs and compile flags
- customer success (maria) -> customer comms and SLA impact calc
- security (morgan) -> audit KMS usage & ensure no key leakage

maria gonzalez: on-call handoff: I'm on shift for another 45m. If this resurfaces escalate to escalation-oncall (samir).

ops-bot: next oncall window reminder scheduled for 2201238200. incident-bot: marking incident state=mitigated, severity=P1 -> monitoring for 60m before close.

alex chen: quick note for runbook: if pin fails to reduce error_rate, fallback option = route to public-hosted safe variant and open dedicated-pool scaling ticket (scale set dedicated-eu-west-4a +2 gpus). Command:

```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool dedicated-eu-west-4a --delta +2 --reason "mitigate OOMs for AureliaBank"
```

maria gonzalez: thanks everyone. I'll update postmortem template with timeline and link to artifacts. closing thread and moving to postmortems after 60m of stable signals. :white_check_mark:
